sources.title: Task-completion and resource distinctions
sources.details: A verbatim request requires every requested character, so knowing one name cannot entail complete transcription. A summary may paraphrase and therefore has a different target. Identical submitted requests need equivalent requirement satisfaction, not identical wording. File hashing compares bytes; a UI connection proves routing, not semantic quality. Storage payload excludes runtime states and workspaces, so file bytes cannot logically establish a minimum RAM/VRAM capacity. No numeric model-quality theorem is inferred.
